title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build with early Shorts filtering, Shorts survivor diagnostics, and the captured ad-playback neutralizer.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 8 includes the revision 7 standalone isAdPlayback experiment, moves the Remove Shorts JSON.parse hook ahead of app_api to close the same fresh-launch timing window already fixed for ad blocking, and upgrades the on-TV report to diagnostics v5. The Shorts diagnostics count known removals and safely inventory Shorts/reel schema clues found in array entries that survived the conservative classifier, without retaining titles, tracking values, URLs, tokens, or arbitrary payload strings.

added: Shorts survivor diagnostics that record safe schema clues and object paths for Shorts/reel-looking array entries that were intentionally not removed by the known classifier.
On-TV diagnostics v5 summary counts and a dedicated Shorts survivor/signal inventory section.
Regression coverage for unknown Shorts-like schemas and for early Shorts hook installation.
changed: The Shorts JSON.parse hook now initializes beside adblock before app_api, closing the fresh-launch response race that could let initial Home Shorts render before filtering was installed.
DEV version advanced to 8690.5.3 / GTV revision 8 while retaining the revision 7 exact-shape isAdPlayback=true neutralizer.
fixed: Shorts could leak into the first rendered responses because upstream loaded shorts.js after app_api even though GTV had already moved adblock ahead of app_api.
